inputs.locator: Decision feature: DAILY_POSITIVE_RETURN_QUOTE_VOLUME_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN. For exactly 24 H1 bars wholly inside the latest complete UTC day, estimate quote volume as close times base volume, sum it when close is strictly above open, divide by total estimated quote volume, then divide by the median of exactly the prior 20 complete-day shares. Admit only at or above the frozen threshold. Individual zero-volume hours are retained; non-positive daily total fails closed. Aggressor-side, order-book, cross-venue, later-bar, alternate candle-rule, formula, lookback or threshold inference is forbidden.

Frozen variants and accounting: lower neighbor 0.8, primary 1.0 and upper neighbor 1.2; Design 2019-2022, historical Validation 2023-2024 and annual folds 2020-2024. Parent and every variant use 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity, eight 30-USDT lots, 0.10 percent fee each side, 0.05 percent adverse slippage each side, next-open fills, unchanged DRA seven-day cooldown and profit-only exits.

Frozen gate set: require exact corpus and parent parity; primary Design and Validation total PnL strictly higher; Validation realized and unrealized non-worse; Validation drawdown delta at most +0.25pp; median and P90 holding non-worse; at least four Validation interventions; at least 3/5 annual total-PnL wins and 4/5 annual drawdown non-worse; positive annual delta concentration at most 60 percent; both neighbors improve Validation total PnL, stay within drawdown tolerance and have adequate support. Every gate must pass.

objective: Evaluate exactly one frozen directional-volume-participation DRA V1 entry-admission mechanism on the sealed pre-2025 H1 corpus. Compare the unchanged equal-capital parent with primary 1.0 and frozen 0.8/1.2 neighbors. Retain one prior for a separately frozen hypothesis only if Design, Validation, annual breadth, concentration, drawdown, holding, underwater duration, utilization, realized/unrealized PnL and terminal inventory pass the unchanged declarative gate set; otherwise close the family without tuning. This is an H1 directional participation proxy, not true order flow, clean OOS, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization.

performance_case.causal_mechanism: DRA already requires a positive 24-hour close and rising EMA20, but the same endpoint can arise from broad participation or from price movement unsupported by the day's reported volume. Weighting positive H1 candles by estimated quote volume tests whether stronger same-day directional participation identifies more robust positive-momentum entries before the unchanged next-open fill without changing trend horizon, total-volume threshold, exits or size.
performance_case.claim_boundary: This task may establish only one post-hoc pre-2025 historical mechanism conclusion for exact same-equity DRA V1 with versus without DAILY_POSITIVE_RETURN_QUOTE_VOLUME_SHARE_TO_PRIOR_20D_MEDIAN admission. Historical Validation is not clean OOS and the proxy is not taker order-flow imbalance. A positive result retains a prior for at most one separately frozen hypothesis; it is not independent alpha, a candidate, a runtime filter or Trading authorization. The task cannot inspect post-2024 outcomes, change a relation, threshold, lookback, candle rule, weighting, runner or gate, create a hypothesis or candidate, open OOS, deploy or mutate canonical state.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: The feature is valuable only if it rejects weakly supported positive-momentum endpoints without merely suppressing participation or moving losses into terminal inventory. The frozen equal-capital screen therefore requires PnL breadth, drawdown non-inferiority, holding tails, underwater duration, utilization, realized-lot support and neighbor stability together.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: The veto can miss profitable low-volume breakouts and can mistake candle direction for buyer initiative. One frozen screen either retains the proxy for one future hypothesis or closes it before order-flow labeling, alternate candle rules, threshold tuning, OOS access or runtime implementation consumes research capacity.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: Under identical 250 USDT initial equity, effective 240 USDT whole-lot capacity and unchanged DRA V1 economics, admitting signals only when the latest complete day's positive-return estimated quote-volume-share ratio is at or above 1.0 of its prior-20-day median will improve fee-adjusted total PnL in Design and historical Validation while preserving realized and unrealized components and maintaining acceptable drawdown, holding, underwater, annual-breadth and concentration paths.

decision_time.availability_rule: At each unchanged DRA complete-UTC-day decision, all 24 H1 OHLCV bars wholly inside the just-completed day and every share in the prior 20-complete-day median are known before the next-open fill; the incomplete day and every later bar are excluded.
